Alger, 7 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — L'Ag: Algiers, August 7, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Algerian Investment Promotion Agency (AAPI) is publishing the first issue of its biannual magazine Investment.Dz. This publication aims to strengthen the attractiveness of the national territory and support ongoing economic reforms.
Le magazine passe en revue les avancées: The magazine reviews regulatory advancements and tax incentives designed for investors. It highlights the missions of the AAPI and the Supreme Appeals Commission to secure the rights of project initiators. Analyses on strategic partnerships and national projects are also featured.
Le numéro aborde les enjeux de développe: The issue addresses sustainable development challenges, including food and water security, as well as opportunities in local value chains.
